parts.notes: Only package is SO-4. Orderable numbers are ASSR-1218-003E (tube, 100 units) and ASSR-1218-503E (tape and reel, 1500 units); the option code differs only in packing, and the trailing E (RoHS compliant) appears on every orderable number, so mpn is the base number. Datasheet gives no maximum LED turn-on current: led_operate_current is the recommended minimum IF(ON) (3mA, max 20mA); footnote says the switching threshold is IF>=0.5mA but 5mA is recommended over temperature. Output off-capacitance is not specified (only input-output capacitance 0.4pF typ). On-resistance is 0.2Ohm typ. Output leakage 1uA max @ VO=60V. Load current derates with temperature (Fig. 1). Turn-on/off typ 0.13ms/0.06ms. Clearance/creepage 4.9mm/4.9mm. The KiCad footprint pads (0.8x1.2mm at +/-3.0mm, 2.54mm pitch) match the datasheet land pattern exactly; its descr cites this datasheet.

notes: Family datasheet AV02-0173EN also covers ASSR-1219 (DIP-6, AC/DC or DC connection) and ASSR-1228 (2 Form A, DIP-8); excluded per task scope.

Broadcom option codes: the leading digit is the package/packing option (0 = standard through-hole or SO tube, 3 = gull-wing SMD tube, 5 = tape and reel), the middle digits identify the package (03 = SO-4, 01 = DIP-6, 02 = DIP-8), and the trailing E means RoHS compliant. For ASSR-1218: -003E = SO-4 tube, -503E = SO-4 tape and reel.
